evidence.title: Improving GPT‑5.6 Sol in ChatGPT—and expanding access to GPT-5.6 Luna for free users

summary: OpenAI has enhanced ChatGPT with the improved GPT-5.6 Sol model and is now offering free users access to GPT-5.6 Luna. The updates aim to deliver better performance and broader availability of advanced AI capabilities.
title: ChatGPT Upgrades to GPT-5.6 Sol and Expands Free Access to GPT-5.6 Luna
